narr: Thunderstorms developed in a weakly capped, conditionally unstable airmass along an old outflow boundary. Some of these storms produced large hail and localized flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. A video on social media showed water flowing over a low water crossing on Guenther Rd. at Lane Pool Creek south of La Grange.
lsr: PUBLIC VIDEO SHOWS WATER FLOWING OVER THE ROAD AT THE LOW WATER CROSSING AT GUENTHER ROAD AND LANE POOL CREEK WITH ROAD CLOSURE IN PLACE.
